verdict.rationale: Remote's own pricing and marketing pages document onboarding and paying contractors in 190+ countries, with one-click or auto-pay invoice approval, as part of its contractor management offering. The evidence never explicitly addresses paying in contractors' local currencies or providing locally compliant contractor agreements. The country-specific dynamic schemas apply to employments generally rather than to contractor contracts specifically. missing for 10: evidence of local-currency payouts, evidence of compliant or localized contractor contract templates, independent or hands-on corroboration of contractor payments.
